title: PipelineHalt Truth Gate lock (pipelinehalt/truth-gate-lock/v1)
description: Written by `pipelinehalt truth-gate lock` (approval: null) and approved by the author with `truth-gate approve`. approval.digest is SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every field except `approval` and `paperSource.clarifications`; any other edit invalidates the approval.

semantics.description: Path of Semantics.lean relative to the Lake project root

roots.description: Modules imported by the gate scripts

prefixes.description: Module prefixes that count as the project

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized source (comments stripped, whitespace collapsed; def header and body)

exprSha256.description: SHA-256 of the elaborated type and value as printed by Lean

hash64.description: Lean structural hash (mixHash of type and value hashes), checked by the in-build #eval audit

direction.description: iff: formal_claim ↔ paper_claim; formal_implies_paper: formal_claim → paper_claim

dependencies.description: Project-local constants paper_claim unfolds to → SHA-256 of their elaborated type and value

headlines.description: Public whitelist; at least one must have type paper_claim

auxiliary.description: Theorems outside the gate → reason. Never presented as certified.
